parsed.refutation_attempt: The source of user input is validated by checkCellChoice() before the board index is used. In selectCell, after reading the choice at line 71, the while loop (lines 72‑74) repeatedly checks checkCellChoice(choice). checkCellChoice implements a bounds check (line 20) that rejects any value outside the range 1‑9. Since board indices are derived from choice-1 (line 75) or choice (for the bot), and choice is guaranteed to be in 1‑9, the array access is always within bounds. The numeric_limits<int>::max() trigger is therefore handled by checkCellChoice and never reaches the sink. No other code path bypasses this check. Hence the claim of an integer overflow vulnerability is unfounded.
